about.title: The Quest for the Lost Heart

points.1: Step into the boots of Alessandra Morioka, a daring archaeologist on a mission to uncover the Lost Heart of Arachne.
points.2: Originally developed as an academy thesis and later refined into a technical demo, this project showcases a custom third-person framework.
points.3: Inspired by classics like Tomb Raider, the project focuses on bridging character mechanics with reliable backend systems in C++.

points.1: Advanced Traversal: A multi-modal movement system including climbing, ledge navigation, and underwater swimming mechanics.
points.2: Environmental Interaction: Complex puzzle-solving using key-door mechanics and inventory-based triggers.
points.3: Tactical Combat: Encounter diverse AI threats (animals, robots, humans) with modular weapon systems and ammunition management.
points.4: Exploration: Three distinct atmospheric zones: Ancient Temple, a Lake with an Underground Cave, and Open Ruins.

points.1: Component-Based Logic: Custom C++ components for Climbing, Swimming (with breath resistance), and Inventory management.
points.2: Level Streaming: Implementation of a persistent world with sub-level streaming to eliminate loading screens and optimize memory.
points.3: Save/Load System: A robust C++ serialization pipeline that tracks sub-level states, player position, and inventory persistence.
points.4: AI Perception: Enemies utilize custom Sensing Components and Behavior Trees for realistic detection and combat states.
points.5: Custom Collision: Specialized ECC Trace Channels for high-precision shooting, climbing detection, and fluid interactions.

points.1: Save/Load Pipeline: A robust serialization system tracking sub-level states, player progression, and inventory persistence.
points.2: Localization: Built-in translation framework with runtime toggle between English and Italian.
points.3: Interactive UI: 3D Main Menu widgets integrated into the game environment with layered ambient audio design.
points.4: Performance: Extensive profiling and asset optimization to maintain a stable and optimized experience on Windows.
